vetSays.line: 🛡️ Sean, Mai and Alla met them at the door — 3 put down. Sean, Mai, Alla are hurt.
🛡️ Sean, Mai, Alla and Alejandra met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Sean, Mai, Alejandra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mai just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sean just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sean, Alla, Alejandra and Ines met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Sean, Alejandra, Ines are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sean, Alla, Alejandra and Ines met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Sean, Alla, Alejandra, Ines are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sean just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sean, Alejandra and Ines met them at the door — 3 put down. Ines is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Zoltan was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Zoe taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Zoe drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Sean strikes the Scarred The Landlord.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Landlord falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Landlord!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Devon and Tashi met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Devon, Tashi are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Aria met them at the door — 1 put down. Aria is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Greta, Tashi, Aria and Liam met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Greta, Aria, Liam are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
